messages.subject: compare decay rates
parts:
dear list!

i've produced decay rates for dung piles throughout various geographic
regions and would like to compare the decay rates statistically. the
sample sizes are small (all < 40 and all of them different). i have no
idea how to compare the decay rates, as classical tests are not
applicable due to the small sample size and the family of the fitted model.
as i would like to publish these values, the method used has to be 100%
appropriate, thus i would like to avoid the z-test.
any ideas?
thanks in advance!
